title_zh: 达娃次仁主持召开市委理论学习中心组集体学习会
title_en: Dawa Ciren Chairs Collective Study Session of CPC Lhasa Municipal Committee
summary_zh: 8月5日，自治区党委常委、拉萨市委书记达娃次仁主持召开市委理论学习中心组集体学习会，强调深入学习贯彻习近平总书记关于城市工作的重要论述。
summary_en: On August 5, Dawa Ciren, Member of the Standing Committee of the Regional Party Committee and Secretary of the Lhasa Municipal Party Committee, chaired a collective study session of the Municipal Party Committee Theoretical Learning Center Group on Xi Jinping's important expositions on urban work.
